level_1.title: Level 1: Shallow Clifford
level_1.description: Protect a shallow 3-qubit Clifford state with low gate noise.

level_2.title: Level 2: Medium Depth Clifford
level_2.description: Higher depth introduces cumulative noise. Balance check count vs. retention.

level_3.title: Level 3: Deep Clifford Endurance
level_3.description: Deep circuit with heavy noise. Over-checking will crash shot retention!

level_4.title: Level 4: Light T-Doping
level_4.description: First non-Clifford gate introduced. Place hand-made Z-checks on commuting lines.

level_5.title: Level 5: Medium T-Doping
level_5.description: Multiple T-gates degrade baseline fidelity. Apply Z-checks strategically.

level_6.title: Level 6: Universal Gauntlet
level_6.description: High depth combined with heavy T-doping. Maximum protection challenge.
